title: A Hybrid Kinematic GCN and Elastic Transformer for Efficient Indian Sign Language Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.14680v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sign Language Recognition (SLR) presents complex challenges due to variable signing speeds and spatial intricacies. Specifically, Indian Sign Language (ISL) requires precise modeling of its inherently bimanual nature and is bottlenecked by the scarcity of large-vocabulary benchmarks and the inability of standard models to handle irregular signing velocities. To address this, a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient, gloss ISL recognition is proposed. To minimize computational redundancy, an entropy-driven SVD sampler that dynamically extracts informative keyframes is used. Because this subsampling creates irregular physical time gaps, the proposed architecture employs a Continuous Dual Positional Encoding paired with a distance-aware Elastic Transformer to preserve natural signing rhythm. translated_abstract: 手语识别（SLR）由于打手语速度的可变性以及空间上的复杂性而面临复杂的挑战。具体而言，印度手语（ISL）需要对其固有的双手协同特性进行精确建模，并且受到大型词汇基准数据集稀缺以及标准模型无法处理不规则打手语速度的瓶颈制约。为解决这些问题，本文提出了一种结构感知的混合框架，用于高效的词汇级印度手语识别。为了最小化计算冗余，该方法采用了一种熵驱动的SVD采样器来动态提取信息丰富的关键帧。由于这种子采样会产生不规则的物理时间间隔，所提出的架构采用连续双位置编码，配合距离感知的弹性变换器来保持自然的手语节奏。在空间维度上，一种运动学条件化的自适应图卷积网络（GCN）使用统一的骨骼-关节特征来显式建模双手几何结构。为了验证我们的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结构感知的混合框架，通过熵驱动的SVD关键帧采样减少计算冗余，结合连续双位置编码与距离感知弹性变换器保持自然手语节奏，并利用运动学条件化自适应GCN建模双手几何结构，从而实现高效且能应对不规则打手语速度的印度手语识别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structurally-aware hybrid framework for efficient Indian Sign Language recognition, combining an entropy-driven SVD keyframe sampler, continuous dual positional encoding with a distance-aware elastic transformer, and a kinematically-conditioned adaptive GCN to handle irregular signing velocities and bimanual geometry.
